National Investment Services Decreased Holding in Apple Com (AAPL) by $793,562 as Shares Rose; Bp Plc (Put) (BP) Holder Exane Derivatives Cut Position by $718,143 
March 11, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade 
Exane Derivatives decreased its stake in Bp Plc (Put) (BP) by 67.3% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Exane Derivatives sold 2,451 shares as the company’s stock rose 10.53% with the market. The institutional investor held 1,191 shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $350,000, down from 3,642 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Exane Derivatives who had been investing in Bp Plc (Put) for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $131.20 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.51% or $0.2   $39.66. About 3.33M shares traded. BP p.l.c. (NYSE:BP) has risen 15.51%   underperformed by 1.19% the S&P500. 
National Investment Services Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc Com (AAPL) by 36.55% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. National Investment Services Inc sold 5,153 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 8,946 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $1.38 million, down from 14,099 at the end of the previous reported quarter. National Investment Services Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $913.22B market cap company. The stock increased 1.72% or $3.04   $179.98. About 32.19M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48%   outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
Analysts await BP p.l.c. (NYSE:BP) to report earnings on May, 1. They expect $0.66 EPS, up 43.48% or $0.20 from last year’s $0.46 per share. BP’s profit will be $2.18 billion for 15.02 P/E if the $0.66 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.64 actual EPS reported by BP p.l.c. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 3.13% EPS growth. 
Among 29 analysts covering BP ( NYSE:BP ), 20 have Buy rating, 2 Sell and 7 Hold. Therefore 69% are positive. BP had 58 analyst reports since July 24, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. As per Wednesday, July 26, the company rating was downgraded by Societe Generale. Piper Jaffray maintained BP p.l.c. (NYSE:BP) on Wednesday, February 7 with “Buy” rating. The company was maintained on Monday, July 11 by Jefferies. The stock of BP p.l.c. (NYSE:BP) earned “Hold” rating by Jefferies on Friday, January 19. The company was maintained on Tuesday, October 24 by Cowen & Co. On Tuesday, February 6 the stock rating was maintained by Cowen & Co with “Hold”. The company was downgraded on Friday, June 30 by Kepler Cheuvreux. The firm earned “Neutral” rating on Friday, March 18 by Nomura. Societe Generale upgraded the stock to “Buy” rating in Monday, February 12 report. The rating was upgraded by Credit Suisse to “Outperform” on Thursday, December 1. 
Exane Derivatives, which manages about $534.70 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Philip Morris (NYSE:PM) by 21,303 shares to 21,553 shares, valued at $2.39M in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in India Earnings Fd (EPI) by 303,221 shares in the quarter, for a total of 305,891 shares, and has risen its stake in Nat.Retail Prop. (NYSE:NNN). 
Since October 3, 2017, it had 0 insider purchases, and 5 selling transactions for $26.38 million activity. The insider Riccio Daniel J. sold $2.42M. AHRENDTS ANGELA J sold $9.78M worth of stock.
